notes:
Adds color-coded Site groups and playlist channel labels for Adult-TV-Channels.com, OXAX.tv, Adult-TV-Channels.click and FuckFlix.click.

Adult-TV-Channels.com uses orange, OXAX.tv uses green, and both .click Sites use yellow; the Cumination Add-on suffix is shown in violet.

Adds Adult-TV-Channels.click and FuckFlix.click to playlist creation and update, including dedicated PVR_CLICK and PVR_FUCKFLIX resolver modes.

Update Playlist now rebuilds the managed Adult TV Test playlist from the currently discoverable channels so existing entries are migrated to the new four-Site grouping and naming scheme without duplicates.

Playlist display names remove trailing Online text and use the original channel name where possible; Penthouse TV is normalized to Penthouse Gold.

PVR_OXAX now follows the same fresh page, candidate and header handling used by the working direct OXAX playback path while returning the resolved stream to PVR IPTV Simple.

Normal Custom Site playback, Settings, Senderstatus prüfen, thumbnails, Landscape Wall support and self-update behavior remain otherwise unchanged.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
